stem: An 11-year-old boy has testicular enlargement with a testicular volume of 4 mL; which pubertal event does this most strongly indicate?
explanation: Gonadarche is the correct answer. In boys, testicular enlargement to about 4 mL marks the onset of gonadarche.

citations.title: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because adrenarche refers to adrenal androgen secretion and does not begin with testicular enlargement.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because pubarche refers to the development of pubic hair and related androgenic changes, not gonadal enlargement.
optionExplanations.C: Correct because testicular enlargement to a volume of 4 mL is a classic marker of gonadarche in boys.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because this finding indicates the start of puberty, not its completion.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because a testicular volume of 4 mL is evidence of pubertal change rather than absence of puberty.
